verdict.rationale: Evidence shows a path to acquire taken/expiring domains via the Auctions API (bidding and Buy Now closeouts), which serves as a broker-like path for taken names, but there is no evidence of premium domain pricing being surfaced distinctly in standard search/availability results, nor a dedicated aftermarket/marketplace listing experience for premium names beyond expired-domain auctions. missing for 10: premium pricing flagged in search-availability responses, a marketplace/broker UI or API for currently-registered (not just expired) premium domains, and independent confirmation that premium pricing displays correctly.
